title: Capturing Changes in Social Media Content: A Multiple Latent Changepoint Topic Model
eligible_reason: Methods paper: a topic model (LDA with a Dirichlet-process HMM) that detects latent changepoints in brand-related social media content. No DiD regression; the package ships only simulated documents.
design_notes: lda_dphmm_code.m runs a Gibbs sampler (C++ mex) on data_sim.mat (train/test word-document-period triplets). Regression inventory is empty.
data_files_note: readme: 'data_sim.mat' with simulated calibration and holdout data.
software_notes: MATLAB with C++ mex Gibbs samplers.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; abstract and package read.
